## What it is

<!-- KEEP:what-it-is:START -->
The general ledger of erp-core (PF-009 / CCR-ACC-001, ADR-GL-001 … 004): a per-tenant chart of accounts whose ids are
stable and never reused (`GL_ACCOUNT`: code, bilingual name, type, an optional header parent of the same type, postable
and active flags), explicit non-overlapping fiscal periods that are OPEN or CLOSED (`GL_FISCAL_PERIOD`; every status
change is published on the outbox as `gl.FiscalPeriodStatusChanged`), the currencies a tenant's ledger accepts with
their minor units (`GL_TENANT_CURRENCY`, defaults from a built-in ISO 4217 table — SAR 2, OMR 3), balanced, idempotent,
immutable journal entries posted by modules (`GlPostingApi`: kind AUTOMATIC | OPENING, an idempotency key per tenant, lines
with a stable `accountId`, a party reference and opaque tags; `GL_JOURNAL_ENTRY` / `GL_JOURNAL_LINE` / `GL_JOURNAL_LINE_TAG`),
read back by id, source document, lines and totals (`GlEntryQueryApi`), manual journals DRAFT → POSTED and reversals on the
`GL_JOURNALS` screen (ADR-GL-005, 006; every post publishes `gl.JournalEntryPosted`), and the trial balance computed at read
time from posted lines (`GET /api/v1/gl/trial-balance`: per account and currency, opening = lines before `from` and closing as
a net side, period movements gross, one totals row per currency — ADR-GL-007; nothing is ever stored as a balance), with
the exports `GL_TRIAL_BALANCE`, `GL_ACCOUNT_LIST` and `GL_JOURNAL_LIST` through the report module (screen `GL_REPORTS`,
permissions `GL:REPORT:<CODE>`). Screens: `GL_ACCOUNTS`, `GL_PERIODS`, `GL_CURRENCIES`, `GL_JOURNALS`,
`GL_TRIAL_BALANCE` (module `GL`). It is not a reporting-currency translator, a budget or a workflow engine, and it ships
no seed chart: a tenant creates its own accounts, periods and currencies.
<!-- KEEP:what-it-is:END -->

## When to use it

<!-- KEEP:when-to-use:START -->
Whenever a business module handles money: map your account roles (a sales account, a VAT account, a bank account) to
`AccountView.accountId`s found through `GlAccountLookupApi` and store those opaque ids in your own configuration — never
the codes, which a tenant may change. Post each document's accounting effect once through `GlPostingApi.post` with an
idempotency key of your own (your document's id is a good one): a retry returns the first entry with `alreadyPosted = true`,
so a redelivered event or a restarted job never posts twice. Put the facts you will need to read back on the lines as tags
(`country`, `tax-category`, …) and the counterparty as `partyRef`; `GlEntryQueryApi.totals` groups by them. Subscribe to
`gl.FiscalPeriodStatusChanged` with an `OutboxSubscriber`: a post refused with `PERIOD_CLOSED` can be retried once the
period is OPEN again. Corrections are new entries (a reversal or a manual journal in gl, or a new automatic entry of yours).
The binding rules are the [ledger](../conventions.md#ledger) convention.
<!-- KEEP:when-to-use:END -->

## How to call it

<!-- KEEP:how-to-call:START -->
```java
// pick a postable, active account for a role — the caller's tenant only, by code or by either name
Page<AccountView> candidates = glAccountLookupApi.search("vat", true, PageRequest.of(0, 20));
Optional<AccountView> byCode = glAccountLookupApi.findByCode("2300");
```

```java
// resolve a stored role mapping at posting time; the id is opaque and stable, the code may have changed
AccountView account = glAccountLookupApi.get(roleMapping.accountId())
    .orElseThrow(() -> new LocalizedException(Status.BUSINESS_RULE_VIOLATION, AccErrorCodes.ACCOUNT_ROLE_UNMAPPED, role));
if (!account.postable() || !account.active()) { /* ACCOUNT_NOT_POSTABLE will be the posting answer */ }
```

```java
// react to a reopened period (outbox, step 11 posts)
@Component
class RetryOnPeriodReopened implements OutboxSubscriber {
    public String code() { return "acc.retry-on-period-reopened"; }
    public String module() { return "acc"; }
    public Set<String> eventTypes() { return Set.of(GlEvents.FISCAL_PERIOD_STATUS_CHANGED); }
    public void handle(OutboxMessage message) { /* payload {tenant, periodStart, periodEnd, status} */ }
}
```

```java
// post one balanced entry, idempotently (the key is unique per tenant; the content is hashed)
PostEntryRequest request = new PostEntryRequest("acc-invoice-" + invoice.id(), "acc", "acc", "INVOICE", invoice.number(),
    invoice.date(), "SAR", EntryKind.AUTOMATIC, new LocalizedText("فاتورة " + invoice.number(), "Invoice " + invoice.number()),
    List.of(new PostEntryLine(receivable.accountId(), invoice.total(), null, "CUST-" + invoice.customerId(), Map.of("country", "SA"), null),
            new PostEntryLine(revenue.accountId(), null, invoice.net(), null, Map.of("country", "SA", "tax-category", "S"), null),
            new PostEntryLine(vatOutput.accountId(), null, invoice.vat(), null, Map.of("country", "SA", "tax-category", "S"), null)));
PostedEntryRef ref = glPostingApi.post(request).getData();   // ref.alreadyPosted() on a retry; a refusal is a LocalizedException
```

```java
// read back: the entry of a document, the lines of an account, VAT totals grouped by the tags you posted
List<EntryView> entries = glEntryQueryApi.findBySource("acc", "INVOICE", invoice.number());
Page<LineView> lines = glEntryQueryApi.lines(new LineQuery(List.of(receivable.accountId()), from, to, "acc", null, null), PageRequest.of(0, 50));
List<AccountTotal> vat = glEntryQueryApi.totals(new TotalsQuery(List.of(vatOutput.accountId()), from, to, "acc", null, false,
    List.of("country", "tax-category")));   // one row per (country, tax-category) value; lines without a key under ""
```

The trial balance and the exports are the accountant's (HTTP, not an in-process API): `GET /api/v1/gl/trial-balance?from=2026-02-01&to=2026-02-28&currency=SAR&postableOnly=false`
(`PERM_GL_TRIAL_BALANCE_VIEW`) → `{from, to, currency, postableOnly, rows [{accountId, accountCode, name {ar, en}, accountType,
currency, openingDebit, openingCredit, periodDebit, periodCredit, closingDebit, closingCredit}], totals [{currency, …the six
sums, balanced}]}`; `POST /api/v1/report/GL_TRIAL_BALANCE/export?format=xlsx` `{"params": {"from": …, "to": …, "currency": …}}`
(`GL:REPORT:GL_TRIAL_BALANCE`), likewise `GL_ACCOUNT_LIST` (`code`, `accountType`, `postable`, `active`) and
`GL_JOURNAL_LIST` (`from`, `to`, `kind`, `status`, `currency`). A module that needs a balance computes it with
`GlEntryQueryApi.totals` — the trial balance is the same computation.

Error codes a caller sees from the lookup and the queries: none (empty `Optional` / empty page / no rows); from
`GlPostingApi.post`: `MODULE_NOT_ENTITLED`, `GL_POST_REQUEST_INVALID`, `INVALID_TAGS`, `CURRENCY_NOT_SUPPORTED`,
`ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND`, `ACCOUNT_NOT_POSTABLE`, `INVALID_AMOUNT`, `ENTRY_UNBALANCED`, `PERIOD_CLOSED`, `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`
(all `LocalizedException`s — nothing is posted); from the screens: `ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND`, `GL_ACCOUNT_*`, `GL_PERIOD_*`,
`GL_CURRENCY_*`, `GL_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND`, `ENTRY_IMMUTABLE`, `GL_ENTRY_NOT_POSTED`, `GL_ENTRY_ALREADY_REVERSED`,
`GL_DATE_RANGE_INVALID` (`docs/api-docs/gl/index.md`). Events: `gl.FiscalPeriodStatusChanged`, `gl.JournalEntryPosted {tenant, entryId, kind,
postingModule, sourceModule, sourceRef, postingDate}` (`GlEvents`).
<!-- KEEP:how-to-call:END -->

## Do not rebuild

<!-- KEEP:do-not-rebuild:START -->
A chart of accounts, account hierarchies or account "roles" stored by code, a fiscal calendar or period lock of your own, a
currency table with decimal places, a journal or posting table, a balance or running-total table kept in step by hand
(balances are computed from posted lines), a numbering of entries (`GL_JOURNAL` is a core number series), an idempotency
store for your posts (the ledger keeps the key and the content hash), a reversal or correction mechanism of your own on
posted entries (post a new entry, or let the accountant reverse in gl), a trial balance, an opening-balance table or an
account / journal export of your own (`GL_TRIAL_BALANCE`, `GL_ACCOUNT_LIST`, `GL_JOURNAL_LIST`).
<!-- KEEP:do-not-rebuild:END -->
